mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in the most recent month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate above 3.5% and unemployment rate above 4.0% signals a monetary tightening cycle with labor market stress, leading to sharp corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.5% and UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market recovery regime with new home construction exceeding 1,400,000 units annually, rising consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1,400.0 (thousands of units), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production growth over the prior two months indicates expanding manufacturing output and strong economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO increases over the prior two months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below 650,000 million dollars in the most recent month, it signals weak consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS is below 650,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a labor market recovery phase with job growth exceeding 100,000 jobs in the prior month, rising consumer spending and corporate profits drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL above 2.5%) and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS above 3.0%) signals an inflationary monetary policy response that increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5 and FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
